datasets.description: Seeded synthetic impacts from the V1 model with a published truth. Exists so the pipeline can be exercised without inventing measurements.
referenceConditions: no air drag, no Magnus, no spin decay in the generator

splitRule: explicit splitAssignment fixed before fitting; a group absent from it falls back to SHA256(group) mod 5: 0 test, 1 validation, else train
notes: EMPIRICAL_DATA is MISSING in this repository: no MEASURED_RAW, PUBLISHED_MEASUREMENT or DIGITIZED_MEASUREMENT record exists, so no empirical calibration is possible.
The single dataset present is SYNTHETIC. It is usable for software verification only.
Adding measured data: create the record file, register the source above with its access date and SHA-256, add the dataset entry, and fix the split assignment before any fitting.
